scope.method: Read-only dnlib metadata and IL inspection of the current local Managed directory after reviewing existing reports.
scope.privacy: No runtime credentials, tickets, player identifiers, names, IPs, payloads or private network destinations are included.

conclusion: Normal Steam player-data publication, server-tag publication and scheduling of existing genuine analytics batches are available to inspect or conditionally invoke. No plugin entry point guaranteeing public trusted-player-count inclusion was found or validated.

normalPaths.finding: The internal managed BUpdateUserData wrapper returns a bool. SteamServer.UpdatePlayer discards it with pop; UpdatePlayerSession returns void. The current game-level call-site scan finds UpdatePlayerSession only in Auth_Steam success, not EndSleeping or respawn.
normalPaths.limit: A missing observed return value is not evidence of an actual failure. Native acceptance does not acknowledge public trusted-count eligibility.

normalPaths.finding: SteamServer.IsValid gates publication. cp directly uses activePlayerList.Count without a per-player sleep, first-tick or EAC filter in that count expression.
normalPaths.limit: No direct A2S_INFO players assignment occurs in this path. Native Steam count formulas and public trusted counts remain separate.

path: Steam validation / actual ClientReady / actual disconnect / normal aggregate and performance loops
normalPaths.finding: Real callbacks and scheduled loops produce the normal server events. The shared event table is not itself a public trusted-player admission API.
normalPaths.limit: Replaying OnSteamAuth or OnPlayerConnected would create synthetic lifecycle records rather than diagnose the original callback. It is not a proposed repair.

normalPaths.flushSemantics: AnalyticsTable.Flush is public and only sets nextUploadStamp to DateTime.Now. It makes the existing batch eligible on a later manager check; it creates no event and performs no HTTP itself.
normalPaths.limit: Enabled, DryRun, current queue/accumulator and manager behavior still apply. HTTP success and uploaded bytes do not acknowledge individual event ingestion or trusted-count inclusion.

normalPaths.finding: IsAuthenticated returns whether connection2status contains value 2. The authStatusEAC ok string is a separate admission state affected by strictauth_eac. A remote status callback additionally initiates asynchronous EOS ID token verification.
normalPaths.finishLoading: For an existing interface and client handle, OnFinishLoading sets IsNetworkActive=true. It does not create authentication success or mutate the status dictionary.
normalPaths.limit: Do not equate a handle, ok string, FinishLoading, SDK status and final ID-token verification. No plugin should set these states or invoke synthetic authentication callbacks.

excludedApproaches: Changing active-player collections, player counts, query responses or backend reports to claim extra players.
Synthetic calls to OnSteamAuth, OnPlayerConnected or EAC authentication callbacks to create success records.
Changing EAC status dictionaries, bypassing EOS token checks or disabling authentication.
Directly posting fabricated player/count data to a public or private backend.
Installing or executing FakePlayers.dll, contacting its embedded service or modifying its license.

comparisonToUnknownDll.finding: The sample visibly patches Update, administrator chat and Ping. Its background HTTP initiation and substantive operations remain resource-protected. No complete call chain from that sample to normal Steam player-data publication or the trusted-count backend has been established.
comparisonToUnknownDll.capacityLimit: Its verified IList mismatch affects a visible administrator chat-command branch. It does not establish failure of the periodic path or provide a trusted-count repair.
